1.english_reference: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ שְׁנַת֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֑ט
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀκτωκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει βασιλεύοντος Ἰεροβοὰμ υἱοῦ Ναβὰθ
traditions.VUL: Igitur in octávo décimo anno regni Ieróboam fílii Nabat ,
traditions.KJV: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat

traditions.WLC: מָלַ֥ךְ אֲבִיָּ֖ם עַל יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: βασιλεύει Ἀβιοὺ υἱὸς Ἰεροβοὰμ ἐπὶ Ἰουδά ,
traditions.VUL: regnávit Abíam super Iudam .
traditions.KJV: reigned Abijam over Judah .

2.english_reference: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem .

traditions.WLC: שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἓξ ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ·
traditions.VUL: Tribus annis regnávit in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem .

2.english_reference: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Maachah , the daughter of Abishalom .

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת אֲבִישָׁלֽוֹם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄνομα τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Μααχά , θυγάτηρ Ἀβεσσαλώμ .
traditions.VUL: nomen matris eius Máacha fília Abéssalom .
traditions.KJV: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Maachah , the daughter of Abishalom .

3.english_reference: And he walked in all the sins of his father , which he had done before him :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּ כָל חַטֹּ֥אות אָבִ֖י ו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה לְ פָנָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ αἷς ἐποίησεν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Ambulavítque in ómnibus peccátis patris sui , quæ fécerat ante eum :
traditions.KJV: And he walked in all the sins of his father , which he had done before him :

3.english_reference: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God , as the heart of David his father .

traditions.WLC: ו וְ לֹא הָיָ֨ה לְבָב֤ וֹ שָׁלֵם֙ עִם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י ו כִּ לְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ τελεία μετὰ Κυρίου θεοῦ αὐτοῦ ὡς ἡ καρδία τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: nec erat cor eius perféctum cum Dómino Deo suo , sicut cor David patris eius .
traditions.KJV: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God , as the heart of David his father .

4.english_reference: Nevertheless for David ’s sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem ,

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י לְמַ֣עַן דָּוִ֔ד נָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֥י ו ל֛ וֹ נִ֖יר בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι διὰ Δαυεὶδ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ Κύριος κατάλειμμα ,
traditions.VUL: Sed propter David dedit ei Dóminus Deus suus lucérnam in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless for David ’s sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem ,

4.english_reference: to set up his son after him ,

traditions.WLC: לְ הָקִ֤ים אֶת בְּנ וֹ֙ אַחֲרָ֔י
traditions.LXX: ἵνα στήσῃ τέκνα αὐτοῦ μετ᾽ αὐτὸν
traditions.VUL: ut suscitáret fílium eius post eum ,
traditions.KJV: to set up his son after him ,

traditions.WLC: ו וּֽ לְ הַעֲמִ֖יד אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ στήσῃ τὴν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: et statúeret Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and to establish Jerusalem :

5.english_reference: Because David did [ that which was ] right in the eyes of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה דָוִ֛ד אֶת הַ יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἐποίησεν Δαυεὶδ τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: eo quod fecísset David rectum in óculis Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: Because David did [ that which was ] right in the eyes of the LORD ,

5.english_reference: and turned not aside from any [ thing ] that he commanded him all the days of his life ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא סָ֞ר מִ כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֗ הוּ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֔י
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἐξέκλινεν ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et non declinásset ab ómnibus , quæ præcéperat ei cunctis diébus vitæ suæ ,
traditions.KJV: and turned not aside from any [ thing ] that he commanded him all the days of his life ,

5.english_reference: save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite .

traditions.WLC: ו רַ֕ק בִּ דְבַ֖ר אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַ חִתִּֽי
traditions.VUL: excépto sermóne Uríæ Hethǽi .
traditions.KJV: save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite .

6.english_reference: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life .

traditions.WLC: וּ מִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֧ה בֵין רְחַבְעָ֛ם וּ בֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָ֖ם כָּל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽי ו
traditions.VUL: Attamen bellum fuit inter Róboam , et Ieróboam omni témpore vitæ eius .
traditions.KJV: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life .

7.english_reference: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam , and all that he did , [ are ] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

traditions.WLC: וְ יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י אֲבִיָּם֙ וְ כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה הֲ לֽוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ יָּמִ֖ים לְ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν λόγων Ἀβιοὺ καὶ πάντα ἃ ἐποίησεν , οὐκ ἰδοὺ ταῦτα γεγραμμένα ἐπὶ βιβλίῳ λόγων τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν Ἰούδα ?
traditions.VUL: Réliqua autem sermónum Abíam , et ómnia quæ fecit , nonne hæc scripta sunt in Libro verbórum diérum regum Iuda ?
traditions.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam , and all that he did , [ are ] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

7.english_reference: And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam .

traditions.WLC: וּ מִלְחָמָ֥ה הָיְתָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין אֲבִיָּ֖ם וּ בֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πόλεμος ἦν ἀνὰ μέσον Ἀβιοὺ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Ἰεροβοάμ .
traditions.VUL: Fuítque prœ́lium inter Abíam et inter Ieróboam .
traditions.KJV: And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam .

8.english_reference: And Abijam slept with his fathers ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אֲבִיָּם֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Ἀβιοὺ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ εἰκοστῷ καὶ τετάρτῳ ἔτει τοῦ Ἰεροβοάμ ,
traditions.VUL: Et dormívit Abíam cum pátribus suis ,
traditions.KJV: And Abijam slept with his fathers ;

8.english_reference: and they buried him in the city of David :

traditions.WLC: ו וַ יִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖ וֹ בְּ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ θάπτεται μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ ἐν πόλει Δαυείδ ·
traditions.VUL: et sepeliérunt eum in civitáte David :
traditions.KJV: and they buried him in the city of David :

8.english_reference: and Asa his son reigned in his stead .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖ וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ βασιλεύει Ἀσὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ᾽ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: regnavítque Asa fílius eius pro eo .
traditions.KJV: and Asa his son reigned in his stead .

9.english_reference: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah .

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ שְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְ יָרָבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֥ךְ אָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: Ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ τῷ τετάρτῳ καὶ εἰκοστῷ τοῦ Ἰεροβοὰμ βασιλέως Ἰσραὴλ βασιλεύει Ἀσὰ ἐπὶ Ἰούδαν ,
traditions.VUL: In anno ergo vigésimo Ieróboam regis Israel regnávit Asa rex Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah .

10.english_reference: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem .

traditions.WLC: וְ אַרְבָּעִ֤ים וְ אַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τεσσεράκοντα καὶ ἓν ἔτος ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ·
traditions.VUL: et quadragínta et uno anno regnávit in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem .

10.english_reference: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Maachah , the daughter of Abishalom .

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת אֲבִישָׁלֽוֹם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄνομα τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἀνά , θυγάτηρ Ἀβεσσαλώμ .
traditions.VUL: Nomen matris eius Máacha fília Abéssalom .
traditions.KJV: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Maachah , the daughter of Abishalom .

11.english_reference: And Asa did [ that which was ] right in the eyes of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֧עַשׂ אָסָ֛א הַ יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν Ἀσὰ τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: Et fecit Asa rectum ante conspéctum Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And Asa did [ that which was ] right in the eyes of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: כְּ דָוִ֖ד אָבִֽי ו
traditions.LXX: ὡς Δαυεὶδ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: sicut David pater eius :
traditions.KJV: as [ did ] David his father .

12.english_reference: And he took away the sodomites out of the land

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲבֵ֥ר הַ קְּדֵשִׁ֖ים מִן הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀφεῖλεν τὰς τελετὰς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ,
traditions.VUL: et ábstulit effeminátos de terra ,
traditions.KJV: And he took away the sodomites out of the land ,

12.english_reference: and removed all the idols that his fathers had made

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨סַר֙ אֶת כָּל הַ גִּלֻּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν πάντα τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα ἃ ἐποίησαν οἱ πατέρες αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: purgavítque univérsas sordes idolórum , quæ fécerant patres eius .
traditions.KJV: and removed all the idols that his fathers had made .

13.english_reference: And also Maachah his mother , even her he removed from [ being ] queen

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֣ם אֶת מַעֲכָ֣ה אִמּ֗ וֹ וַ יְסִרֶ֨ הָ֙ מִ גְּבִירָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν Ἀνὰ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ μετέστησεν τοῦ μὴ εἶναι ἡγουμένην ,
traditions.VUL: Insuper et Máacham matrem suam amóvit , ne esset princeps
traditions.KJV: And also Maachah his mother , even her he removed from [ being ] queen ,

13.english_reference: because she had made an idol in a grove

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָ֥ה מִפְלֶ֖צֶת לָ אֲשֵׁרָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καθὼς ἐποίησεν σύνοδον ἐν τῷ ἄλσει αὐτῆς ·
traditions.VUL: in sacris Priápi , et in luco eius , quem consecráverat :
traditions.KJV: because she had made an idol in a grove ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכְרֹ֤ת אָסָא֙ אֶת מִפְלַצְתָּ֔ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξέκοψεν Ἀσὰ τὰς καταδύσεις αὐτῆς
traditions.VUL: subvertítque specum eius , et confrégit simulácrum turpíssimum ,
traditions.KJV: and Asa destroyed her idol ,

13.english_reference: and burnt [ it ] by the brook Kidron

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂרֹ֖ף בְּ נַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνέπρησεν πυρὶ ἐν τῷ χειμάρρῳ τῶν κέδρων .
traditions.VUL: et combússit in torrénte Cedron :
traditions.KJV: and burnt [ it ] by the brook Kidron .

14.english_reference: But the high places were not removed

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ בָּמ֖וֹת לֹא סָ֑רוּ
traditions.LXX: τὰ δὲ ὑψηλὰ οὐκ ἐξῆρεν ·
traditions.VUL: excélsa autem non ábstulit .
traditions.KJV: But the high places were not removed :

14.english_reference: nevertheless Asa ’s heart was perfect with the LORD all his days

traditions.WLC: רַ֣ק לְבַב אָסָ֗א הָיָ֥ה שָׁלֵ֛ם עִם יְהוָ֖ה כָּל יָמָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: πλὴν ἡ καρδία Ἀσὰ ἦν τελεία μετὰ Κυρίου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: Verúmtamen cor Asa perféctum erat cum Dómino cunctis diébus suis :
traditions.KJV: nevertheless Asa ’s heart was perfect with the LORD all his days .

15.english_reference: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated , and the things which himself had dedicated , into the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֵא֙ אֶת קָדְשֵׁ֣י אָבִ֔י ו ו קדש ו בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν τοὺς κίονας τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ , καὶ τοὺς κίονας αὐτοῦ εἰσήνεγκεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: et íntulit ea , quæ sanctificáverat pater suus , et vóverat , in domum Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated , and the things which himself had dedicated , into the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: כֶּ֥סֶף וְ זָהָ֖ב וְ כֵלִֽים
traditions.LXX: ἀργυροῦς καὶ χρυσοῦς καὶ σκεύη .
traditions.VUL: argéntum , et aurum , et vasa .
traditions.KJV: silver , and gold , and vessels .

16.english_reference: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days

traditions.WLC: וּ מִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֜ה בֵּ֣ין אָסָ֗א וּ בֵ֛ין בַּעְשָׁ֥א מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל יְמֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πόλεμος ἦν ἀνὰ μέσον Ἀσὰ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Βαασὰ βασιλέως Ἰσραὴλ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας .
traditions.VUL: Bellum autem erat inter Asa , et Báasa regem Israel cunctis diébus eórum .
traditions.KJV: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .

17.english_reference: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֨עַל בַּעְשָׁ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέβη Βαασὰ βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ Ἰούδαν ,
traditions.VUL: Ascéndit quoque Báasa rex Israel in Iudam ,
traditions.KJV: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֖בֶן אֶת הָ רָמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Ῥααμὰ
traditions.VUL: et ædificávit Rama ,
traditions.KJV: and built Ramah ,

17.english_reference: that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּ֗י תֵּ֚ת יֹצֵ֣א וָ בָ֔א לְ אָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ μὴ εἶναι ἐκπορευόμενον καὶ εἰσπορευόμενον τῷ Ἀσὰ βασιλεῖ Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: ut non posset quíspiam égredi vel íngredi de parte Asa regis Iuda .
traditions.KJV: that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .

18.english_reference: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold [ that were ] left in the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king ’s house

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֣ח אָ֠סָא אֶת כָּל הַ כֶּ֨סֶף וְ הַ זָּהָ֜ב הַֽ נּוֹתָרִ֣ים בְּ אוֹצְר֣וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֗ה וְ אֶת אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית מלך
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἀσὰ τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸ χρυσίον τὸ εὑρεθὲν ἐν τοῖς θησαυροῖς τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως ,
traditions.VUL: Tollens ítaque Asa omne argéntum , et aurum , quod remánserat in thesáuris domus Dómini , et in thesáuris domus regíæ ,
traditions.KJV: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold [ that were ] left in the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king ’s house ,

18.english_reference: and delivered them into the hand of his servants

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּתְּנֵ֖ ם בְּ יַד עֲבָדָ֑י ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὰ εἰς χεῖρας παίδων αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: et dedit illud in manus servórum suórum :
